review_method: Visually rechecked all 22 rows and all six new/used cells against the complete Pirelli Motorsport RACE SETS graphic reproduced by Coffee Corner Motorsport on 8 November (image SHA-256 4fa0c4973d2b83cdad026696bf9fa066e9d27fd89ed1844175c64cb38ccb8714); matched every entrant to the current official Starting Grid. Every driver has one new C3 Hard and one new C4 Medium; the ten Q3 drivers have four new C5 Softs, and the other twelve have five. The article explicitly says no used slick remains available after wet-only Qualifying. This is the remaining race inventory, not a claim that slicks were unused in practice; Pirelli's 6 November report records slick running in FP1/FP2 and its 7 November report says Qualifying used only wet-weather tyres. Counts ordered soft new/used, medium new/used, hard new/used.
